entities.summary: Tahirid, a notable figure in the history of Yemen, associated with Rasulid Golden Age (1350–1454). Preceded by Late Rasulid Decline and Rasulid Prosperity and Aden Trade. Their legacy influenced Tahirid dynasty overthrows the Rasulids, ending Yemen's golden age and Ottomans conquer Aden and coastal Yemen.
